faq.q: What is the best boat for the F1 Grand Prix 2040 weekend in Marbella?
faq.a: For a group of up to 12 guests, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) or Mangusta 80 (24m) offer spacious decks, sun pads, and flybridge seating ideal for watching the race. If you prefer a sportier ride, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) is a great choice. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How much does an F1 Grand Prix yacht charter cost in Marbella 2040?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) are €4,719 minimum for 4 hours, including a free jet ski. Other boats like the Ferretti 94 or K80 are priced on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What is included in the F1 Grand Prix yacht charter?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You can also add a private chef, champagne, or a DJ setup for an extra fee.

faq.q: Can I watch the F1 Grand Prix from the boat?
faq.a: Yes, you can anchor near the coast or in the bay with a clear view of the circuit, or stream the race live on the boat's TV system (available on request). The skipper will position the boat for the best experience.

faq.q: How many guests can I bring on the yacht?
faq.a: Capacity varies by boat: the Azimut 58 Flybridge and Mangusta 80 both take up to 12 guests, while the Azimut 39 takes 11, and the Astondoa 40 takes 9. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are ideal for intimate groups.

faq.q: What is the best time to book for the F1 Grand Prix 2040?
faq.a: Book as early as possible – ideally 3-6 months in advance – as demand peaks. The Grand Prix typically takes place in May; confirm the exact dates on the official F1 calendar. We recommend a 6-8 hour charter to enjoy the race and then cruise to Cabopino or Estepona.

faq.q: Do you offer catering or special packages for the F1 weekend?
faq.a: Yes, we can arrange gourmet catering, a private chef, premium champagne, and even a DJ or sound system. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss your requirements and get a custom quote.

faq.q: Where do the boats depart from?
faq.a: All boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. You can also arrange pickup from Marbella Marina or Cabopino for an additional fee. The skipper will meet you at the dock.

data.body_html:
Experience the 2040 Formula 1 Grand Prix weekend like never before with a luxury yacht charter from Puerto Banús, Marbella. Skip the crowded grandstands and watch the race from the water, with a cool breeze, unlimited drinks, and your own private skipper. Our fleet includes the Azimut 58 Flybridge, Mangusta 80, and Ferretti 94 – all departing from the iconic Puerto Banús. Whether you want a 2-hour blast or a full-day cruise, we have the perfect boat for your F1 Grand Prix yacht charter Marbella 2040 weekend.

Why choose a yacht charter for the F1 Grand Prix 2040?

The Monaco Grand Prix may be the most famous, but Marbella's F1 weekend offers a unique blend of racing action and Mediterranean luxury. By chartering a private yacht, you avoid traffic jams, enjoy VIP service, and can combine the race with a coastal cruise to Cabopino or Estepona. Our all-inclusive pricing means no hidden extras – just turn up and enjoy.

Our top boats for the F1 weekend

Here are the most popular boats for groups celebrating the Grand Prix:

  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – Spacious flybridge with panoramic views, perfect for socialising.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – Open-plan layout, sun pads, and a free jet ski included from €4,719 for 4 hours.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – Ultimate luxury with multiple decks, a jacuzzi, and a crew of 3.
  • Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) – Sporty and fast, ideal for a quick getaway between sessions.
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – Affordable option from €749 for 2 hours, with drinks and snacks included.

All boats depart from Puerto Banús. For pricing on the Ferretti 94 or K80, please contact us via WhatsApp.

Pricing and inclusions

Our F1 Grand Prix yacht charter Marbella 2040 packages are straightforward:

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You can upgrade to a private chef, champagne, or a DJ for an extra fee.

Sample itinerary for the F1 weekend

Here's a typical 8-hour charter plan:

  • 10:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús, welcome drink and safety briefing.
  • 10:30 – Depart towards the coast, anchor near the circuit area for the race.
  • 12:00-14:00 – Watch the F1 race from the boat (streaming available on request).
  • 14:00 – Cruise to Cala del Faro or Cabopino for a swim and lunch.
  • 16:00 – Return to Puerto Banús, enjoy sunset drinks on the way.

Customise your itinerary – add a stop at Estepona or Sotogrande – by contacting us via WhatsApp.

Book early for the 2040 Grand Prix

Demand for F1 Grand Prix yacht charter Marbella 2040 weekends is extremely high. We recommend booking at least 3-6 months in advance to secure your preferred boat and time slot. To reserve, simply send us a WhatsApp message with your group size, preferred boat, and any special requests. We'll confirm availability and send a booking link.
